headline: B2B Sales & Business Development Professional | Lead Generation & Client Relations
summary: Results-oriented Business Administration graduate with a strong foundation in B2B sales, lead generation, and client relationship management. Proven ability to drive growth through strategic outreach, cold calling, and pipeline management. Skilled in cross-cultural communication (Arabic/English) and remote collaboration, with a track record of delivering high-quality client acquisition and retention. Eager to leverage analytical skills and sales acumen to secure qualified meetings and drive business growth at Toptal.

experience.title: Business Development & Client Relations Specialist
bullets: Executed B2B sales strategies to acquire new clients across MENA, EU, and Asian markets, focusing on lead generation and pipeline development.
Conducted multi-channel outreach (email, LinkedIn, phone) to prospect, qualify, and nurture sales-ready leads, resulting in consistent client acquisition.
Managed end-to-end client relationships, from initial contact and needs assessment to proposal negotiation and closing, ensuring high satisfaction and retention.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align sales efforts with technical delivery, ensuring accurate client expectations and successful project handoffs.
Analyzed market trends and competitor activities to refine outreach messaging and improve conversion rates in target segments.

experience.title: Community & Marketing Manager
bullets: Supported user growth and engagement by identifying new business opportunities and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and KOLs.
Developed and executed campaign strategies that increased lead generation and community participation across multiple regions.
Collaborated with internal teams to align marketing initiatives with business goals, contributing to overall pipeline growth and brand visibility.

cover_letter: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Enterprise Sales Development Representative role at Toptal. With a background in Business Administration and hands-on experience in B2B sales, lead generation, and client relations, I am eager to contribute to your team's growth. I excel in remote environments, leveraging cross-cultural communication skills to build rapport with diverse clients. My track record in driving pipeline growth through strategic outreach and diligent follow-up aligns perfectly with Toptal's goals. I am a fast learner, highly motivated, and ready to hit the ground running to secure qualified meetings and support your sales force.

screening.q: Do you have experience with B2B sales or lead generation?
Are you comfortable with cold calling and outbound outreach?
Do you have experience using CRM software?
Are you available to work in a remote, US-time-zone-aligned environment?
Do you have a degree in Business Administration or a related field?
